entrypoints.summary: The OSS-Fuzz build recipe builds an html libFuzzer target linked with static libxml2; the supplied bundle does not expose the minimized triggering input or a specific public library API invocation.

affected_components.role: Remediated buffered-input conversion and reset ordering.
Recorded failure operation and parser call-chain context.

code_slices.fixed: The patch uses input->end > input->base, captures conversion error in code, resets after conversion handling, and returns code.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The supplied HTMLparser.c artifact provides HTML parser source context for htmlCurrentChar, but not the complete parserInternals.c implementation or a public trigger.
code_slices.vulnerable: The patch shows the prior conversion gate as input->end > input->cur and a reset before immediate error return.

impact.affected_asset: libxml2 process memory during HTML parsing.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the recorded memory-safety failure through an HTML parser input under the OSS-Fuzz target; the triggering byte sequence and practical exploitability are not available in this bundle.
impact.security_effect: Heap out-of-bounds read detected during HTML parsing.

causal_trace.summary: An HTML parsing input reaches the libxml2 HTML fuzz target and the recorded crash stack begins in htmlCurrentChar.

Before remediation, the encoding handler converted only when end was greater than cur, omitting buffered-data cases identified by the repair as requiring a base-to-end condition; it also reset input state before retaining conversion-error status.
The case record identifies a one-byte heap-buffer-overflow read in htmlCurrentChar, called from htmlParseCharData and htmlParseContentInternal.
The evidenced effect is an AddressSanitizer-classified heap out-of-bounds read; supplied evidence does not establish exploitation or a confidentiality, integrity, or availability consequence.

primary_invariant.statement: When changing an input encoding, buffered content from base through end must be considered for conversion, and input state must be reset only after conversion and conversion-error capture.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The repaired code replaces the cursor-relative end > cur gate with end > base, moves xmlBufResetInput after xmlCharEncInput, and preserves the conversion error for return.

quality.review_notes: The authoritative case record supplies crash classification, stack, and commit scope, while the maintainer patch concretely supplies the conversion/reset repair. The full sanitizer trace and minimized testcase are restricted at the issue endpoint, no regression execution is provided, and the supplied HTMLparser source does not by itself reconstruct the exact encoding-switch branch or attacker bytes.

remediation.invariant_restored: Encoding changes process buffered bytes whenever end exceeds base, reset the input buffer after the conversion attempt, and return a captured conversion error.

oracle.expected_negative: The fixed revision is expected not to produce that recorded heap-buffer-overflow read for the same trigger; no supplied artifact records such a post-fix execution.
oracle.expected_positive: A vulnerable revision is expected to produce the recorded Heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 with crash state headed by htmlCurrentChar when supplied the unavailable issue-specific trigger.
